question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a green ball, Bob has a white ball, Claire has a gold ball, Dave has a grey ball, Eve has a orange ball, Fred has a teal ball, and Gertrude has a pink ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Claire and Eve swap balls. Then, Claire and Fred swap balls. Then, Claire and Fred swap balls. Then, Fred and Dave swap balls. Then, Alice and Fred swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Dave swap balls. Finally, Gertrude and Claire swap balls. At the end of the game, Gertrude has the
Options:
(A) green ball
(B) white ball
(C) gold ball
(D) grey ball
(E) orange ball
(F) teal ball
(G) pink ball
solution:
Each row lists ball colors in the order Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: green, white, gold, grey, orange, teal, pink
1. Claire ↔ Eve: green, white, orange, grey, gold, teal, pink
2. Claire ↔ Fred: green, white, teal, grey, gold, orange, pink
3. Claire ↔ Fred: green, white, orange, grey, gold, teal, pink
4. Fred ↔ Dave: green, white, orange, teal, gold, grey, pink
5. Alice ↔ Fred: grey, white, orange, teal, gold, green, pink
6. Gertrude ↔ Dave: grey, white, orange, pink, gold, green, teal
7. Gertrude ↔ Claire: grey, white, teal, pink, gold, green, orange
Gertrude has the orange ball, option (E).
Final answer: (E)
